Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross to Score David Fincher's 'The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth'

03 Nov 2026, 09:50 AM IST · GlobeWire Daily Entertainment Desk · Source: variety.com

A Continuing Cinematic Partnership

Academy Award-winning composers Trent Reznor and Atticus Ross are reportedly set to score David Fincher's upcoming film, "The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth." According to promotional details revealed on the movie's poster, this project marks the sixth time the Nine Inch Nails principals have collaborated with Fincher on a feature film.

The creative partnership between Reznor and Ross and Fincher began with 2010’s "The Social Network," a project that earned the duo Academy Award and Golden Globe victories for best original score. Their ongoing collaboration continued through subsequent films, including "The Girl With the Dragon Tattoo" (2011), "Gone Girl" (2014), "Mank" (2020), and "The Killer" (2023). For their work on "The Girl With the Dragon Tattoo," they also secured a Grammy Award in 2013 for best score soundtrack for visual media.

Release Details and Project Background

Reported promotional details indicate that "The Further Mis-Adventures of Cliff Booth" will receive an exclusive IMAX release on November 25, running for two weeks. Following the theatrical window, the movie is scheduled to become available for streaming on Netflix beginning December 23.

The film functions as a spin-off of the 2019 feature "Once Upon a Time in Hollywood," centering specifically on the character played by Brad Pitt. Reported details note that the script was written by Quentin Tarantino and is set eight years after the timeline of the original film. The ensemble cast features Elizabeth Debicki, Scott Caan, Carla Gugino, Timothy Olyphant, and Yahya Abdul-Mateen II.
